# Folder selection flattens Gmail groups in both traversal entry paths

The adapter replaces a matching grouping-folder entry with its children before sorting raw folders. It applies this both inside recursion and before the single-server mode enters recursion, since that mode omits the root row. Server-array and default modes retain root rows. Selection still returns the original folder objects stored on rows; the offline and virtual-folder consumers use flags or URIs. This changes displayed hierarchy, not native folder identity, and adds no new test assertions.

Scope: Folder-selection adapter construction and identity.
